question: Who recognizes that all this activity belongs exclusively to the speaker?
premises: All this work belongs to the speaker alone.
The treasure of the world knows this.
inference: The treasure of the world knows that all this work is the speaker's alone.
uncertainties: The epithet jagat+nidhiḥ likely refers to Brahma but is not explicit.
plain_english: All this work is mine alone; indeed, the treasure of the world knows this.
